svg.text: Gateway challenges → Node authenticates → Gateway accepts with state snapshot
Gateway registers node in NodeRegistry (if role=node)
Nonce is included in the node's device signature payload
to prevent replay attacks. Node must echo this nonce back
in device.nonce of the connect request.
Node → Gateway (must arrive within 10s handshake timeout)
"minProtocol": 3, // int, minimum supported version. Currently always 3.
"maxProtocol": 3, // int, maximum supported version. Currently always 3.
"displayName": "My MacBook Pro" // str?, macOS: scutil --get ComputerName. Linux: os.hostname()
"deviceFamily": "iPhone15,2" // str?, mobile device model identifier. undefined for desktop.
"instanceId": "b4e5f6..." // str?, nodeId for nodes, randomUUID() for UI clients
"device": { // obj?, Ed25519 cryptographic identity. Required for nodes.
"id": "a1b2c3d4..." // str, SHA-256 hex of raw public key. Persisted: ~/.openclaw/identity/device.json
"publicKey": "xYzABC..." // str, base64url raw Ed25519 pub key (32 bytes, SPKI prefix stripped)
"signature": "sig123..." // str, base64url Ed25519 sig. Payload below. Max skew: ±2 min.
"signedAt": 1711234567890 // int, Date.now() when signature was created
"auth": { // obj?, undefined for unauthenticated local connections
"token": "gw-tok-..." // str?, shared gateway token (config) OR resolved device token (fallback)
"bootstrapToken": "boot-..." // str?, single-use 10-min onboarding token from `openclaw qr`
"deviceToken": "dev-..." // str?, explicit per-device token (used in retry after token mismatch)
Only one primary mechanism is sent per attempt. Source: src/gateway/client.ts selectConnectAuth()
Gateway → Node (connection accepted, full state snapshot)
"health": {/* HealthSummary or {} if not cached yet */}
Capability token: randomBytes(18).base64url. Embedded in URL path. Expires in 10 min.
"auth": { // obj?, only when device identity present
Generated by ensureDeviceToken(). Returns existing token if valid, or generates new. Persisted in pairing DB.
Client stores auth.deviceToken → disk. Starts tick watcher (close if no msg in tickIntervalMs×2).
Gateway registers node in NodeRegistry, records presence, sends voicewake.changed event, triggers health refresh.
